name: @bearing/bifrost-sdk
description: Print to a Bluetooth printer from a web page, via the Bifrost bridge. Works with any framework.
//exports: Comment keys must NOT live inside `exports`. Node rejects an exports object that mixes keys
starting with '.' and keys that do not — ERR_INVALID_PACKAGE_CONFIG — which makes the whole
package unimportable. It only shows up once the package is installed somewhere, never here.
./global is dist/index.global.js: the <script> build that defines window.Bifrost, for Razor,
WebForms and anything without a bundler (FR-704).

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build

//dependencies: Intentionally empty and checked in CI — FR-703. Nothing to audit, nothing to update transitively.
//peerDependencies: Only for the framework entry points. The core imports neither.
